messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High-severity — Stripe event delivery failures observed for multiple customers. Billing sync jobs are failing with repeated 429s and some customers are being flagged as 'suspended' by quota-enforcement process. Investigating impact and mitigation. Please acknowledge oncall.

ryan_oncall: Ack. Looking now. Which subsystem is triggering the suspension? billing-service or entitlement-worker?

sara_eng: entitlement-worker is getting webhook failure events from the billing sync lambda. It retries but hits rate limits on Stripe when we backfill. Early sample:

```
POST /v1/events
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit_error",
    "message": "Too many requests made to the Stripe API."
  }
}
```

sara_eng: The webhook queue has ~3k failed deliveries; retry logic is exponential but we're rehydrating events which creates bursts.

maya_billing: Confirmed — some customers see UI state "Payment required" because invoice sync hasn't marked recent payments. That's causing the quota-enforcement job to mark access_locks. Urgent: don't want to block paying customers.

jonathan_sre: Reached out to Stripe status. They show elevated rate-limiting on the ingest endpoint in eu-west. They've acknowledged increased throttling for some accounts. Link: https://status.stripe.com/incident/abc123 (internal note)

ryan_oncall: Short-term mitigation ideas: 1) pause automatic enforcement (grace-mode) for accounts with recent successful charge history, 2) throttle our backfill job to stay under Stripe per-account rate limits, 3) switch to event polling per-customer rather than global burst. Which is fastest?

sara_eng: We can flip grace-mode in the admin console now. It prevents the entitlement-worker from applying locks for 30 minutes across affected tenants. Also can add jitter and a token-bucket limiter to backfill; will take ~10–15m to deploy a hotfix to the worker.

maya_billing: Do it. Flip grace-mode and let support know to not escalate customers automatically. I'll prepare a support note to affected accounts.

support_squad: We'll hold manual escalations. Are we comfortable with a 30m grace window? Need a timeline for backfill completion.

jonathan_sre: Deploying a throttling patch to the backfill orchestrator now (canary to 10% of jobs). If successful, ramp to 100% in ~20m. Also opening a ticket with Stripe support to request temporary rate limit increase/whitelist for our webhook consumer.

sara_eng: Patch deployed to canary — backfill rate now capped to 10r/s with per-customer spacing. Observed failed queue draining slower but no new 429s in canary.

ryan_oncall: Grace-mode toggled ON at admin console by ryan_oncall. Notifying support.

maya_billing: Notified top 25 affected customers via templated message. Copy: "We're aware of delayed billing syncs due to Stripe API rate limiting; we've temporarily suspended automatic access locks while we reconcile. No action required on your part."

support_squad: Getting replies from one customer asking for SLA credit — forwarding to maya_billing.

jonathan_sre: Stripe answered the ticket: they can temporarily increase rate limits for our account for 60 minutes; need confirmation. I'm requesting the whitelist and monitoring the ingestion endpoint.

sara_eng: Backfill now draining without hitting 429s after throttling ramp. We'll continue to run until queue is empty; ETA ~1.5h given new caps.

ryan_oncall: Keep this thread updated with metrics: failed delivery count, number of accounts still locked, and any customer escalations. Also create an incident page and assign postmortem owners.

incident-bot: Action taken: grace-mode enabled, backfill throttled, canary deployed. Assigned: postmortem -> maya_billing, technical lead -> sara_eng, oncall -> ryan_oncall.

maya_billing: I'll own the postmortem write-up and customer comms. Plan: outline root cause (our aggressive rehydration + Stripe regional throttling), mitigation steps taken, and long-term fixes (batching improvements, adaptive backoff, retry-state persistence).

support_squad: We're tracking two customer escalations; will email status updates and escalate to account team if needed.

ryan_oncall: Last note — we should add a pre-flight estimate of allowed concurrency per Stripe account in backfill logic. I'll file a follow-up ticket.

jonathan_sre: Agreed. Logging metrics show peak 429s around 1812345800. I'll attach graphs to the incident page.

sara_eng: Closing updates for now — keeping worker throttled until queue is empty. Will post again if anything changes.

support_squad: Thanks team.
